facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: thermal release during routine operation on P-4101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4101, M-4101 and P-4105 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4101, M-4101 and P-4105 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on P-4101, M-4101 and P-4105 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. P-4101 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during routine operation while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 1 September 2021 an incident occurred on P-4101, M-4101 and P-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
